name: Quasi fiscal policy

subjectOf.text: Adjusting the commercial benefits attached to a token operates as a quasi fiscal policy tool: increasing those benefits raises aggregate demand for a given token supply and can offset the depreciating effect of a large supply in circulation.
subjectOf.abstract: First, the increase in commercial benefits associated with a token heightens the aggregate demand of the given token supply. Second, commercial benefits associated with a token issuance can help offset depreciated supply scarcity
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Marco Dell'Erba, Initial Coin Offerings Emerging Practices, Risk Factors, and Red Flags (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3067615
scope_conditions: tokens carrying discounts or other usage-linked commercial benefits

subjectOf.text: Adjusting commercial benefits associated with a token issuance is preferable to blunt monetary intervention, because it avoids more drastic measures such as emergency sales, building token reserves, or changing the token supply in circulation.
subjectOf.abstract: Fourth, adjusting the commercial benefits associated with a given token issuance avoids more drastic monetary policy intervention by way of emergency sales or building token reserves or a decrease or increase of token supply in circulation.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Marco Dell'Erba, Initial Coin Offerings Emerging Practices, Risk Factors, and Red Flags (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3067615
scope_conditions: issuer management of an outstanding token issuance
